title: people-ops-self-notes-michael-lee-2026-q1
content:
People Ops — Self notes (Michael Lee)
Q4 2025 through Q1 2026 — prep for 1:1 / performance recap / goals

Quick summary:
- Role: People Ops (individual contributor, talent programs / onboarding ops)
- Focus last 6 months: revamp onboarding checklist, pilot onboarding buddy program, run new-hire survey + first-90-day pulse, partner on hiring scorecards for IC roles
- State: feeling good about execution, want to shift more to strategy (scaling onboarding automation + manager enablement)

Wins (evidence / metrics):
- Onboarding checklist redesign: reduced average time-to-first-PR for new hires from 11 days -> 7 days (n=28 hires since July). Source: onboarding-survey + engineering intake notes.
- New-hire pulse: 82% "onboarding satisfied" score in latest cohort (target 75%). Comments flagged walk-through gaps for infra team -> created infra-specific onboarding doc.
- Buddy program pilot (5 teams): qualitative feedback positive, 4/5 teams reported smoother ramp in first 30 days. Plan to scale to 12 teams next quarter.
- Hiring scorecards: worked with eng managers to standardize rubric for IC levels L3-L5; decreased time-to-hire for product roles by ~10% (still early).

Areas to improve / blockers:
- Automation backlog: redcaps in HRIS integration blocking auto-offboarding tasks; still manual steps for contractors. Need eng support or temporary SRE effort.
- Metrics instrumentation: some onboarding metrics live in spreadsheets; want to push to dashboard in Redwood Console for people team (create dashboards + weekly alerts).
- Manager enablement: managers still ask for playbooks on 30/60/90 feedback conversations. Build a simple kit and run 1:1 manager office hours.

Career / development goals (next 6-12 months):
- Move from tactical execution -> program strategy: lead company-wide onboarding replatforming project (owner of scope + rollout plan).
- Build skills: analytics (Looker), product thinking for internal tools, stakeholder management (exec updates).
- Goal metric: reduce time-to-individual-contributor-productivity by another 10% and keep onboarding satisfaction >=80%.

Manager prep (what I want to discuss in 1:1):
- Promo readiness: Do you see me progressing toward Senior People Ops? Evidence I have: program ownership, cross-functional influence, measurable impact. Ask: what are 2 concrete things I must demonstrate before we put me up for promotion?
- Headcount ask: propose 0.5 FTE to support onboarding automation (contractor or junior ops) to clear execution backlog. I can write brief RACI + expected ROI.
- Roadmap alignment: want to prioritize manager enablement kit + onboarding dashboard next quarter. Need clarity on priority vs hiring pipeline work.
- Feedback: ask for candid feedback on stakeholder presence — where do I need to be more visible?

Specific asks / notes for manager:
- Recommend 2-3 cases where I've led cross-org decisions (onboarding checklist, buddy program, hiring scorecards). I can pull threads + metrics for each.
- Request: sponsor a 30-min sync with Eng leadership to unblock HRIS integration (we need an eng partner).
- Compensation context: note that market comp for Senior People Ops has moved; would like calibration conversation if promo path is defined.

Open questions / ToDos (next 30 days):
- Finalize buddy program scale plan (owner list, timeline) — TODO: draft plan by 2026-03-15.
- Draft manager 30/60/90 kit and run pilot office hours — TODO: pilot week of 2026-03-22.
- HQ: create onboarding dashboard spec for any analytics help + request engineering support (owner: TBD).
- Pull qualitative quotes from new-hire pulses for promo packet.

Notes to self / informal reminders:
- Keep timeline and metrics simple for manager conversations — top-line impact + 1-2 examples.
- When asking for headcount, provide time-saved estimate (hrs/week) and cost vs benefit.
- Save Slack threads and CI links that show cross-functional collaboration.

Misc snippets to copy into prep doc:
- "Pilot reduced time-to-first-PR from 11 -> 7 days (n=28) — primary levers: structured checklist, buddy check-ins at day 3 & 14, infra-specific docs."
- "Manager enablement kit will standardize 30/60/90 templates, sample feedback prompts, and suggested weekly 1:1 agenda."

Endnotes / references:
- New-hire pulse (Dec 2025 cohort) — survey doc link: confluence:people-ops/new-hire-pulse-dec2025
- Onboarding checklist version history: slack:#onboarding (thread id msg9981)

---
Rough draft ready for manager review. Keep as working doc — will prune before sending as 1:1 agenda.
